verdict.rationale: Vue's official docs include a Quick Start and a Tooling Guide among its official resources. Independent developers credit official vue-cli scaffolding with making it easy to start and iterate on projects without hand-configuring webpack. One user reports days lost to build-tooling configuration, but that concerns later build/debug setup rather than initial scaffolding, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: first-party detail on the scaffolding command and its time-to-running-app, and current (not legacy vue-cli) hands-on corroboration of the few-minutes claim.
